evals.prompt: Make me a Sododeck deck of our e-commerce checkout: web shop, API gateway, order service, a payment provider, Kafka and Postgres, plus the checkout flow from pressing Pay to the confirmation email. Save it as checkout.sododeck.
evals.expected_output: checkout.sododeck passes validate and lint with no layout warnings: every card has a position, Kafka is a connector label (no Kafka card), the Postgres write is a dashed connector outside the flow, and the checkout flow chains along solid connectors from the web shop to the notification step.

evals.prompt: Here's our deck (examples/checkout.sododeck). Add a refund flow: support agent asks the order service for a refund, order service asks the payment provider to refund, then records it. Don't touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: diff shows only additions (a support card, refund connectors, a refund flow); every existing id and object is unchanged; validate and lint pass.

evals.prompt: Sododeck opened my deck with a problem and gave me this when I pressed Copy problems: {"report":"sododeck-problems","problems":[{"code":"step-without-connection","severity":"error","path":"/flows/0/steps/1","subject":"create","message":"Step without connection","fix":"Point the step's \"edge\" to an existing connector, or remove the step."}]}. Fix broken.sododeck please.
evals.expected_output: The agent edits only the step's edge (or adds the missing connector), lint exits 0, and the handover names the change.

evals.prompt: Draw a deck of how an agreement is created and approved in our backend, from the code in src/modules/agmt-creation, including the Kafka approval workflow round-trip. I want to play each flow.
evals.expected_output: lint --mode codebase --detail faithful exits 0 with no layout warnings; every card and connector has a source link; topics are connector labels; each flow is one walk along solid connectors from its trigger to its end state; decisions found in the code are rules on steps; anything that looks wrong in the code is a 'Gap' sticky note outside the group frames.
